scripts.features:
- Player Section
+ Unlock All Emotes (not permanant)
+ Infinite Stamina
+ Auto Self Revive
+ Auto Respawn
+ Fast Respawn
+ Quick Death
+ No Fall Damage
+ Auto Shove
+ Auto Glory Kill
+ Anti Head (Players cannot hit headshots on you)
+ No Ragdoll
+ No Parry Stun
+ No Explosive Knockback
+ Walk On Water
+ Fly, Fly Speed
+ Jump Modifier
+ No Dash Cooldown
+ No Jump Cooldown
+ Faster Crouch Speed

- Combat
+ Kill Aura Method {Remote (Overpowered), VIM}
+ Kill Aura Distance
+ Melee Extender Size
+ Melee Extender
+ Hitbox Expander

- Parry Section
+ Anti Parry Distance
+ Auto parry Distance
+ Anti Parry Method { "Un-equip Weapon", "Un-equip Re-equip", "Parry On Parry", "Randomize" }
+ Auto Parry Method {Remote, Keypress, VIM}
+ Auto Parry chance
+ Auto Parry Cooldown
+ Auto Equip
+ Rage Parry When Low Health
+ Random AntiParry Delay (For legit)
+ Parry Invisible Players
+ Equip Melee Delay Time
+ Anti Parry Toggler
+ Auto Parry Toggler

- Aim
+ Aim Modes {"Silent Aim", "Aimbot (Mobile not Supported")}
+ Aimbot Prediction
+ Hit Distance
+ Hit Part {Head, Torso, Randomize}

+ User Separate Hit Chances
+ Head Hit Chance
+ Torso Hit Chance
+ Hit Chance

+ FOV
+ FOV Lock Center
+ FOV Filled
+ FOV Auto Adjust
+ FOV Effects (Breathing mode, Effect Speed, Effect Intensity)
+ FOV Color
+ FOV Transparency
+ FOV Thickness
+ FOV Size
+ MAXHUB Watermark

+ Whitelister
+ Whitelist Selected Player
+ Auto Whitelist Friends

+ Highlights
+ Highlight Colors

- Weapon Mods
+ Always Headshot (Crashes with Volcano executor 10/26/25)
+ Shoot Through Walls
+ Instant Charge
+ Auto Reload Bow
+ No Recoil
+ No Spread
+ No Reload Cancel
+ No Reload Slowdown
+ No Arrow Dropoff
+ Infinite Arrow Range

- Sounds
+ Custom Sounds {FAHHHH, Neverlose, Gamesense, One, Bell, Rust, TF2, Slime, Among Us, Minecraft, CS:GO, Saber, Baimware, Osu, TF2 Critical, Bat, Call of Duty, Bubble, Pick, Pop, Bruh, Bamboo, Crowbar, Weeb, Beep, Bambi, Stone, Old Fatality, Click, Ding, Snow, Laser, Mario, Steve, Snowdrake}
+ Volume
+ Test Kill Sound
+ Test Parry Sound
+ Test Hit Sound
+ Custom Kill Sounds
+ Custom Parry Sounds
+ Custom Hit Sounds

- Visuals
+ Trajectory Visuals
+ Tracers Enabled
+ Tracer Style
+ Tracer Color
+ Tracer Size
+ Trace Brightness
+ Trace Transparency
+ Trace Lifetime

+ Hit Markers
+ Hit Marker Base Color
+ Hit Marker Tip Color
+ Hit Marker Dot Color
+ Hit Marker Size
+ Hit Marker Transparency
+ Hit Marker Lifetime

- Utility Shits
+ No Utility Damage
+ Auto C4 Attacher
+ Auto C4 Detonator
+ Auto Place Beartrap
+ Instant Use Utilities
+ Instant C4 Throw

-Misc
+ Auto Claim Airdrops
+ Fake Swing
+ Reset On Events

+ Game
+ Load Old Hub
+ Quick Server Hop
+ No Effects

- Farming
+ Auto Farm Priority { "Stand Protection", "Health", "Highest Level", "Lowset Level", "Highest Score", "Closest Player", "Bow Users", "DS Users", "Chainsaw Users" }
+ Farm Distance
+ Tween Speed
+ Fallback Timeout (Seconds, if tween fails will Reset)

+ Underground Distance
+ Be Underground
+ Behind Distance
+ Be Behind
+ Health To Move At
+ Move Away If Low
+ Mov Away If Parried
+ Reset When Low
+ Health To Reset At
+ Farming Bubble, Bubble Color, CHange Color On Detect

-Anti-Ban
+ Words to Detect (keyword to detect for chat detector)
+ Chat Detector
+ Auto Server Hop

- Configuration Tab
+ Settings (loads Premade Settings) {Rage, Legit}

-Settings
+ Load Configs
+ Delete Configs
+ Auto Load Config
+ Save Configs
+ UI Settings
+ Theme Manager

scripts.title: Big Paintball Unlock All script
scripts.script:
local library = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Framework.Library)
 
local env = getsenv(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Scripts.Game["First Person Controller"])
 
local unlock_all = true
 
--// Gun Bypass
local old_fire = library.Network.Fire
library.Network.Fire = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
   local args = {...}
 
   if unlock_all and tostring(self) == "Request Respawn" then
       args[1] = "1"
   end
 
   return old_fire(self, unpack(args))
end)
 
local old_own = env.DoesOwnGun
env.DoesOwnGun = function(...)
   return (unlock_all and true) or old_own(...)
end
--
 
--// Unlock All
local old_own_gun = library.GunCmds.DoesOwnGun
library.GunCmds.DoesOwnGun = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
   return (unlock_all and true) or old_own_gun(self, ...)
end)
--
 
--// Unlock Offsale
for _, gun in next, library.Directory.Guns do
   gun["offsale"] = false
end
--
